headline: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Climb On Softer Jobs Data And Yields
summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Monday, Aug, 10 2026 US stock futures are pointing higher this morning, with the S&P 500 contracts up around 0.6%, as investors weigh softer US jobs data against falling bond yields and cooler inflation expectations. July nonfarm payrolls showed a small job loss of 23,000 and weaker wage growth, which signals a slowing job market and less pressure from pay rises.
